Title: [LSK] : Daring The Dawn and Mask Of The 1000 Faces + NRA

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
Situation :

Vampire A bleeds with Legal Manipulations at pre. Some vampire blocks
Vampire A plays Daring The Dawn
All players refuse to block.
Vampire B plays Mask of the 1000 Faces and takes over the action.

Questions :

- Who gets the aggrevated damage from Daring the Dawn ( I would say vampire
A, because it says "this vampire")
- Can vampire A bleed again in the same turn (I would say yes, because when
the action resolves B was the acting vampire)
- Vampire B needs to have for/FOR to be able to play the Mask (I would say
yes)
- Vampire B needs to have pre/PRE to be able to play the Mask (I would say
yes)

thx

johannes walch

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Johannes Walch wrote:
> Situation :

Who is LSK?
:-)

> Vampire A bleeds with Legal Manipulations at pre. Some vampire blocks
> Vampire A plays Daring The Dawn
> All players refuse to block.
> Vampire B plays Mask of the 1000 Faces and takes over the action.
>
> Questions :
>
> - Who gets the aggrevated damage from Daring the Dawn ( I would say vampire
> A, because it says "this vampire")

The acting vampire (note the wording in the superior - to rule the other way
would mean that no damage is done at all in superior since the vampire A is no
longer acting)

> - Can vampire A bleed again in the same turn (I would say yes, because when
> the action resolves B was the acting vampire)

Yes.

> - Vampire B needs to have for/FOR to be able to play the Mask (I would say
> yes)

Yes. (for is DtD was played at normal, FOR if DtD was played at superior).

> - Vampire B needs to have pre/PRE to be able to play the Mask (I would say
> yes)

Yes, as above.
